## Testing

## Human action required before flipping to public

- [ ] Confirm the final repository/package licensing decision and update `LICENSE` plus package metadata if needed
- [ ] Confirm `conduct@smepro.tech` as the Code of Conduct contact
- [ ] Enable GitHub Discussions if discussion links should be active
- [ ] Enable private vulnerability reporting / GitHub Security Advisories
- [ ] Enable secret scanning and push protection
- [ ] Enable branch protection on `main` and require CI checks
- [ ] Review repository topics, description, homepage, and social preview
- [ ] Review whether historical commits containing pre-publication proprietary/confidential notices need remediation
